description: Versioned declared stimulus of the unit IO native observer (tools/observe_animation_machine_io.py): per-frame values of the four external-read ports and the declared host writes of every observation configuration. Nothing here is a BIOS, IRQ-timing or device claim: every value is a declaration. Scope: docs/analysis/input-stage-progress-observation-scope.md.

ports.380000: BYTE system port (active low): bit0 P1 start, bit1 P1 select, bit2 P2 start, bit3 P2 select [I: input-sampler.md]
ports.300000: BYTE P1 port (active low): bit0 up, bit1 down, bit2 left, bit3 right, bit4 A, bit5 B, bit6 C, bit7 D
ports.340000: BYTE P2 port (active low), same bit layout as 300000
ports.3c0006: WORD raster / video status read by the frame head (eaa, efc); declared 0

semantics.frame: Frame number k of the D1 frame protocol. Frame 0 is the N0 pass (no head, no external read); the values of frame k >= 1 are served to the H of that frame.
semantics.repeat: A value applies to every read of that port inside the frame (pause loops that read again see the same value).
semantics.defaults: Port values of every frame before any segment applies (all released: BYTE ff, raster 0000).
semantics.segment: {from, to (inclusive, null = open), port, optional every + phase [a, b] (absolute frame number modulo every inside [a, b], inclusive), and one or more of value (replace), clear (bits cleared, active low press), set (bits set)}. Segments apply in file order.
semantics.queue_limit: Optional per-port number of values the frame queue holds (default 32 = FH.QLEN). A read beyond it is the checked stop external-read-queue-empty.
semantics.consumption: What the C++ harness receives is the native consumption log (address, size, value in consumption order), not this table.

none.description: Nothing pressed: all ports released, raster 0.

walkfire.description: IO-1 probe walkfire: from frame 20 P1 right held, A toggling every 4 frames, B pulsed 6 frames out of 64. No start, select or coin bit (scope decision 3).

walkfire-start.description: walkfire plus the P1 start bit (380000 bit0) at frames 5..7, 60..62 and 200..202. Guard fixture only: the start bit makes the c79a menu return to the BIOS (c00444).

none-raster-short.description: Guard fixture: the raster queue holds one value, the frame head reads 3c0006 twice.

game-mode.why: D9 configuration (ii): the stage controller LONG 1008e4 := c7fc (game-mode controller)
D9 configuration (ii): BYTE 10fdaf := 2 (BIOS game mode); b68 copies it to 100012 in the H of frame 1

player-start-p1.why: declared effect of the BIOS PLAYER_START call for P1: BYTE 10f006 |= 1 (OR.B D0,10f006 at ae4); b68 turns the bit into BYTE 10fdb6 := 1 in the H of frame 1
player-start-p1.evidence: a74 -> abc -> OR.B D0,10f006 (ae4); b68 BCLR/MOVE.B #1,(A0,D0.W); scope decision 2

player-start-p2.why: declared effect of the BIOS PLAYER_START call for P2: BYTE 10f006 |= 2
player-start-p2.evidence: a74 -> abc -> OR.B D0,10f006 (ae4); b68; scope section 3.1 configuration P1b

title-start.why: declared first call of the BIOS PLAYER_START (a74) from the title state: it writes BYTE 10fdaf := 2 only; the original later writes BYTE 10fdb6 := 1 itself
title-start.evidence: scope 3.3 (10fdaf = 1, 10fd82 = 0, f004 = 3 -> a74 a92 branch -> 10fdaf := 2 at ab2)

fx-bios-call.why: guard fixture: the controller callback points into the BIOS window outside the declared c00444 / c00468 boundaries

fx-n-input-read.why: guard fixture: node 100bf4 callback := 2634 (MOVE.B 300000,D0 ... RTS), a direct input port read inside N

fx-c-input-read.why: guard fixture: controller callback := 2634 (MOVE.B 300000,D0 ... RTS), a direct input port read inside C

P0.description: control: game-mode declaration (ii), nothing pressed, IRQ execution

P1.description: main configuration: game mode + declared P1 player start at frame 1 + walkfire input

P1b.description: P1 plus the declared P2 player start (class representatives only)

boot-demo-0.description: BIOS-less boot with BYTE 10fdae = 2 (demo request), nothing pressed

boot-title-start.description: BIOS-less boot with BYTE 10fdae = 3 (title), walkfire, BYTE 10fdaf := 2 at frame 100 (declared first PLAYER_START)

boot-title-idle.description: BIOS-less boot with BYTE 10fdae = 3 (title), nothing pressed

fx-start-c79a.description: guard fixture: the P1 start bit in the c79a menu ends the controller in the BIOS (c00444)

fx-queue-short.description: guard fixture: the frame head reads 3c0006 twice, the declared queue holds one value

fx-bios-call.description: guard fixture: a controller callback inside the BIOS window outside c00444 / c00468

fx-n-input-read.description: guard fixture: a node callback reads the input port 300000 directly inside N

fx-c-input-read.description: guard fixture: the controller callback reads the input port 300000 directly inside C
